# `company.pick_entries`

Append-only picks confirmed on a pick list: add or set, with the bin, lot or serial number in hand.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this entry. |
| `pick_list_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with pick_list_id + ordinal | — | pick_lists.id | Pick list the entry confirms. |
| `line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_pick_entries_line | pick_list_lines.id | Pick list line the units were picked for. |
| `ordinal` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with pick_list_id + ordinal | ix_pick_entries_line | — | One-based order of entries on the list. |
| `mode` | VARCHAR(4) | no | — | — | — | — | add (this many more; a scan adds 1) or set (the line holds this many). |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Quantity entered in the item's base unit, microunits. |
| `bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Bin the units were taken from; null for no bin. |
| `lot_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | lots.id | Lot picked; null when unassigned. |
| `serial_number_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | serial_numbers.id | Serial number of the unit picked; null when none. |
| `scanned_code` | VARCHAR(200) | yes | — | — | — | — | Code scanned, when the entry came from a scan; else null. |
| `staging_bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Staging bin the entry moved its units to or from; null: it moved nothing. |
| `entry_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Date the units were picked, YYYY-MM-DD: the staging placements' date. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this pick entry was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this pick entry. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this pick entry. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this pick entry. |
